doc.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023

chapter: The Dorsey band and the road
title: Big band life matching expectations; Woody's band cadenzas
summary: Life on the road was what he expected; he points to his cadenzas on 'Lonesome Old Town' with Woody Herman.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did the anticipation of joining a well-known big band equal the experience when you got with the band then you went on the road on a bus every day, did it get to be the same? Did it get to be this realization that this life is not necessarily what I thought it would be?

No I don’t think so. It was pretty much what I expected it to be. But after a while you start listening to some of the cadenzas I was playing in Woody’s band where “Give Me the Simple Life” began to appear an awful lot.
It is indeed. You know the tape by any chance that I did, “Lonesome Old Town” that was broadcast from England with Woody’s band?
I don’t think I’ve heard that.
Go down to the cadenzas, you’re going to hear a nice version of “Give Me the Simple Life.”
